verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini integration can add labels and bulk-delete emails when the user asks, so AI-assisted organizing exists but is user-invoked rather than automatic triage. The filters in the pack are rule-based and do not count as AI triage. A community report says Gmail's AI spam filtering lets obvious spam through, which bears on classification quality. missing for 10: automatic AI labeling/categorization of incoming mail, AI surfacing of what needs attention, documented ways to steer the AI's triage behavior, audit logs or explanations of AI triage decisions, independent hands-on corroboration of effective triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
